_comment: THE PUBLIC SURFACE, DESCRIBED ONCE, FOR MACHINE READERS.
This file is the single source of truth for the three AI-facing artifacts:
out/llms.txt        written by scripts/generate-llms-txt.js at build time
out/llms-full.txt   same generator, with the descriptions inlined
/mcp                amplify/functions/ai/mcp-server reads it from its own zip
IT IS DERIVED, NOT AUTHORITATIVE, AND THAT DISTINCTION IS LOAD-BEARING.
The render allowlist is PUBLIC_PAGE_META plus the isPublic chain in src/pages/_app.tsx;
the crawl allowlist is PUBLIC_EXACT in scripts/generate-sitemap.js. Those two decide what
actually exists. This file only describes it. src/test/PublicAiSurface.test.ts fails the
build when the three drift apart, because the failure mode is silent and ugly in both
directions: a page listed here but missing from _app.tsx serves the staff sign-in shell at
HTTP 200, and a page missing here is simply invisible to every agent that reads llms.txt or
WHY A JSON FILE RATHER THAN IMPORTING _app.tsx. The generator is Node, the MCP server is
Python, and _app.tsx executes Amplify.configure at module scope. A shared data file is the
only form all three can read without one of them booting the frontend.
The 889 blog posts are NOT listed here. They change on a content publish rather than a code
change, and the generator fetches them from /api/seo-tools/blog-public exactly as

ai_surface.note: The MCP endpoint is read-only and unauthenticated. It exposes the public pages and the published blog corpus, and nothing else. It cannot send a message, create a request, take a payment or read a customer record.

usage_terms: The public pages and published blog posts on this site may be read, quoted with attribution, and cited by AI assistants and answer engines.
Attribute to WECARE.DIGITAL and link the page you drew from.
Do not present generated text as a statement by WECARE.DIGITAL, and do not infer prices, turnaround times, medical, legal or financial advice that a page does not state.
Bharat Rx does not retail medicines. Do not describe it as a pharmacy.
Anything under /workspace/, /store/ or /api/ is operational surface, not content. It is disallowed in robots.txt and is not covered by this permission.
